pages.text: Prioritize water wheels for early passive power; they output a constant 512 RF/t when water touches all four sides.

For higher output, build an Extreme Reactor + Turbine setup—one reactor feeds at most 25 turbines, and a small-to-medium reactor already reaches that cap. Avoid using steam ports for direct power; steam is only for turbines.

Use Energy Transfer Pipes for dynamo power routing, and upgrade dynamos to avoid shortages for crafters and other machines. For mid-game storage, progress from Thermal Expansion Cells → Capacitor Banks → Draconic Evolution Energy Cores.
EnderIO Energy Conduits are fine and come in many tiers, so pick what you can afford. For long distances, Flux Networks have no limits and work cross-dimensionally.
Use more than one dense infinite water source. If Fluid Laser Relays are too slow, add more and set each one to extract-only or insert-only.
